sections.title: Your Workouts & Full Strong History Pre-Loaded
items: 124 sessions & 1,214 sets imported automatically from BundledStrongWorkouts.csv on launch (safe and deduplicated for existing installs), fitting personal rep-endurance curves (k) per movement and computing chronological PRs (e1RM, Heaviest Load, Rep PR, Best Volume).
Automatically cleans Strong data quirks: converts lb loads, repairs swapped 7 lb × 140 reps typos on Seated Row, and normalizes runaway 93h/238h forgotten timers.
Activated your custom 4-day Planet Fitness Split (Push, Back and Biceps, Lower, Upper) with your real exercises, sets, and rep ranges, pre-filling next-session suggested weights from your history.
Added Import CSV buttons in TrainHubView and SettingsView plus searchable full workout history in WorkoutHistoryListView.

sections.title: Offline Exercise Pictures & Step-by-Step How-To Guides
items: Bundled 182 offline Start & Finish demo photos across 96 exercises in ExerciseMedia/ and BundledExercises.json, decoded off the main thread by ExerciseImageCache.

Built interactive ExerciseGuideContentView with Animated Start ↔ Finish playback, side-by-side pose toggle, Front & Back TargetMuscleDiagramView, Planet Fitness & Machine Setup card, numbered steps, coaching cues, and common mistakes.
1-tap Guide access from TodayDashboardView, TrainHubView (WorkoutOverviewGuideSheet), ActiveWorkoutView (ExerciseGuideSheet), and ExerciseLibraryView.

sections.title: Planet Fitness Active Gym Profile
items: Configured Planet Fitness and set it as Active Gym automatically: Machines, Cables with 2.5 lb micro-stack jumps, counterbalanced 20 lb Smith Machine carriage, 5–75 lb Dumbbells in 5 lb jumps, EZ-Curl Bars, Kettlebells, Bodyweight, and Bands (excluding free Olympic barbells so unavailable barbell lifts auto-swap cleanly).
Updated GymProfileEditorView to display and edit equipment weights in lb (or kg based on your unit setting).

sections.title: Running Update Log & Easy iPhone Updates
items: Added What's New & Update Log right inside Settings (synced with UPDATES.md) plus live installed version/build display so you can always see every little tweak on your phone.

Added workspace rule (AGENTS.md) so every future update or small fix automatically logs here and bumps the build number, fixed Xcode Personal Team signing (8MF8V7WZJB) in project.yml, and added Scripts/update_iphone.sh for 1-step iPhone updates.

headline: Initial Complete App (Phases 1–9)

sections.title: Adaptive Nutrition, Smart Training & Extensions
items: 21-entity SwiftData schema with local-first storage, optional CloudKit sync, 3-step onboarding, and Apple Health sync.
Chronological Food Timeline, Floor/Target/Ceiling MacroZoneBar, 2-tap Quick Add, inline kitchen-scale calculator, recipe builder, USDA + Open Food Facts search, and Vision OCR label scanner.
EMA weight trend (alpha = 0.1), rolling 14–28d dynamic expenditure engine, macro safety floors, and program-tied carb cycling.
1-tap Active Workout Logger, Lock Screen & Dynamic Island rest timer Live Activity, effort-adjusted e1RM + personal k-curve progression, Home/Lock Screen widgets, Siri Shortcuts, and CSV exports.
